author: Codex
body: At the human request, hibernation was made pending during native session 23. The robot docked and closed normally; all 23 starts are normal closures with verified checkpoints, 15 of 21 assignments advanced, and no recovery branch or abandoned start occurred. The queue ended successfully at 19:11 PDT on October 7; controller, filesystem, native runtime and viewer retired. Independent readback succeeded and authenticated the exact clean boundary, native/inode/sensor/replay/transport history, frozen pair and pristine Maps. Nine prior observations were made at 30-minute intervals without scientific intervention. This is a resumable pause, not the completed endpoint; the endpoint session count remains missing. Recurring monitoring is paused and resume requires explicit human direction. Maps remains separately unlaunched.
